dag_infos.description: New Taipei City A2 (injury or death after 24 hours) road traffic accident parties by single-year age, gender, injury severity, vehicle category and district. Source ages are retained as integer intervals; valid 18-35 records are exact and are not apportioned.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市A2道路交通事故受傷當事者（單齡年齡、性別、受傷程度、車種、行政區）
data_infos.source_type: 政府資料開放平臺 / 內政部警政署
data_infos.dataset_description: 警政署逐年發布的 A2 道路交通事故逐案資料。A2 定義為造成人員受傷或超過24小時死亡的交通事故；本DAG篩選處理單位為新北市政府警察局，按發生地點解析29個行政區，並依當事者單齡、性別、死亡受傷人數欄位及車種大類別聚合。來源的有效單齡直接存為 age_lower=age_upper，18-35 不需分攤；來源少量明確異常年齡不推估，保留原始值並以 NULL 年齡輸出。資料集編號為109至114年 158864、158865、161199、167905、172969、177136。
data_infos.etl_description: For each ROC year, resolve the current ZIP URL from the server-rendered data.gov.tw catalog page and download it with requests stream=True into a SpooledTemporaryFile. The compressed ZIP is seekable, but A2 CSV members are never decompressed to disk or read into a DataFrame: each member is opened with zipfile.ZipFile.open, wrapped in io.TextIOWrapper, and consumed by csv.DictReader row by row. Non-New-Taipei rows are discarded immediately. New-Taipei rows are aggregated in Counters by district, age interval, gender, injury severity and vehicle, then the yearly counters are released. Missing vehicle, gender and injury keys are filled before aggregation. The source has a death count embedded in the accident-level 死亡受傷人數 field; the ETL checks that this field is consistent within each deduplicated accident and reports its accident-level totals, but it does not label those deaths as age-specific. Input party rows are reconciled to every district and city aggregate, and yearly New-Taipei row counts are checked for a greater-than-threefold scale anomaly. Any new non-numeric, blank, or out-of-range age raises with the raw value; the small set of source anomaly values measured in ROC 109-114 is retained with NULL age and its original age_band_raw.
